quote: A signal of intention to turn right or left, or otherwise turn a vehicle from a direct course, shall be given continuously during not less than the last 100 feet traveled in a business or residential district and not less than the last 300 feet traveled in any other area prior to changing the course of a vehicle. This rule shall be observed, regardless of the weather.

activation.condition: the subject is about to turn right or left, or otherwise change course

obligation.description: A signal of intention to turn right or left, or otherwise turn a vehicle from a direct course, shall be given continuously during not less than the last 100 feet traveled in a business or residential district and not less than the last 300 feet traveled in any other area prior to changing the course of a vehicle. This rule shall be observed, regardless of the weather.

exceptions.trigger: none — the rule states expressly that it is observed regardless of the weather
exceptions.effect: preserve clause scope; no additional exception inferred

timing.description: the signal must run continuously over the last 100 feet before the change in a business or residential district, and over the last 300 feet elsewhere; 'continuously' — a signal switched on and off inside the distance does not satisfy the rule; the trace must cover at least the last 300 feet of approach for the longer case to be decidable

judgment_calls_needed.note: 'business or residential district' is a legal region class: a reading assumption that selects which of the two distances applies
